assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
CPT 93229 is used for mobile cardiac telemetry.
The patient has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
The patient has a diagnosis of dizziness/giddiness (R42).
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
As the authorization was absent, the claim cannot be processed for payment at this time.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
This diagnostic procedure (CPT 93229) is directly supported by the documented clinical indication of recurrent dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia.
